predictions.R1_replication: Descriptive comparison of the selected learning rate (best mean accuracy over K=64,128,256,384, the paper's selection rule) with the paper row 0.998 / 0.853 / 0.384 / 0.217. We call the replication adequate if K=64 accuracy is at least 0.95.
predictions.R2_rewrite_shortcut: Selected model: accuracy with three write passes (K in 4..32) is at least 20 points below two passes. Also reported for the other two learning rates.
predictions.R3_error_identity: Pooled over the three learning rates, at least 50% of three-pass errors return the pass-2 (second) write.
predictions.R4_partial_third_pass: Descriptive: with a third pass rewriting half of the keys, accuracy on rewritten keys versus keys left at their pass-2 value separates "second write" (fails rewritten keys) from "value in the last block" (fails keys absent from it) and from latest-write recall.
predictions.R5_single_pass: Descriptive: accuracy with one write pass (plain MQAR, never seen in training).
predictions.evaluation: eval_kata_replication.py after all three runs finish; fresh evaluation seed 1800000.
